general: Social Simulation Arena (SSA) is an independent, non-commercial research benchmark. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by any publisher whose data it uses. The numbers shown are derived by SSA from public sources as archived at the time stated, and may differ from the publisher's current figures. Names and trademarks belong to their owners.
